behavior.arguments: rdi = output pointer, rsi = string pointer, rdx = length
behavior.branch_order: length == 16 is tested first, then length == 5, then the tag-2 fall-through; the 16-byte path falls through to tag 2 on mismatch
behavior.output_shape: byte 0 of output is always 9, byte 1 is the tag, then ret
behavior.tag_0: length == 5 and first 4 bytes xor 0x69746e75 ("unti", little-endian) is 0 and byte 4 xor 0x6c ('l') is 0, i.e. the string is exactly "until"
behavior.tag_1: length == 16 and the 16 bytes equal the constant at 0x204b10, which reads exactly "required_matches"
behavior.tag_2: every other input (including length 5 that is not "until" and length 16 that is not "required_matches")

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase
